introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: Answer ALL the questions in the spaces provided (10 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: Answer ALL FOUR questions; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Non-programmable calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
incertitudes: Q B1 : barème imprimé par bloc ((i) 8 marks, (ii) 7 marks) ; les parties (i)(a)-(c) sont numérotées a à c et (ii)(a)-(c) numérotées d à f. Le pourcentage de profit est calculé sur le coût (méthode usuelle, le sujet ne précise pas la base) : 56,25 %.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) A palm wine seller buys overnight palm wine at 200 FCFA per litre and fresh palm wine at 400 FCFA a litre. He mixes the overnight palm wine and fresh palm wine in the ratio 2 : 3 before selling to customers. Given that he sells 100 litres of the mixture daily at 500 FCFA per litre.

Find:

(a) the number of litres of fresh palm wine in the mixture that he sells daily.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The ratio overnight : fresh is $2:3$, so there are $2+3=5$ parts in the mixture and fresh palm wine makes up $\dfrac35$ of it.

Fresh palm wine in 100 litres: $\dfrac35\times100=60$ litres.

(The other $\dfrac25\times100=40$ litres are overnight palm wine.)

**Answer: $60$ litres of fresh palm wine.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) the total cost of 100 litres of the mixture.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Cost of the overnight palm wine: $40\times200=8\,000$ FCFA.

Cost of the fresh palm wine: $60\times400=24\,000$ FCFA.

Total cost $=8\,000+24\,000=32\,000$ FCFA.

**Answer: the total cost is $32\,000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) his daily percentage profit. *[8 marks for (i)]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Selling price of the 100 litres: $100\times500=50\,000$ FCFA.

Profit $=$ selling price $-$ cost price $=50\,000-32\,000=18\,000$ FCFA.

Percentage profit $=\dfrac{\text{profit}}{\text{cost price}}\times100=\dfrac{18\,000}{32\,000}\times100=56.25\%$.

**Answer: daily profit $=56.25\%$** (profit of $18\,000$ FCFA on a cost of $32\,000$ FCFA).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(ii) The polynomial $f(x)$ is given as $f(x)=x^3+x^2-4x-4$.

(a) Show that $(x-2)$ is a factor of $f(x)$.
questions.corrige_markdown:
By the factor theorem, $(x-2)$ is a factor of $f(x)$ if $f(2)=0$.

$f(2)=2^3+2^2-4(2)-4=8+4-8-4=0$.

Since $f(2)=0$, $(x-2)$ is a factor of $f(x)$.

Divide $f(x)$ by $(x-2)$: $x^3+x^2-4x-4=(x-2)(x^2+3x+2)$.

Check: $(x-2)(x^2+3x+2)=x^3+3x^2+2x-2x^2-6x-4=x^3+x^2-4x-4$.

Factorize the quadratic: $x^2+3x+2=(x+1)(x+2)$ (two numbers with product $2$ and sum $3$ are $1$ and $2$).

**Answer: $f(x)=(x-2)(x+1)(x+2)$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) Hence, solve the equation $f(x)=0$. *[7 marks for (ii)]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
$f(x)=0\iff(x-2)(x+1)(x+2)=0$.

A product is zero when one of its factors is zero: $x-2=0$ or $x+1=0$ or $x+2=0$.

**Answer: $x=2$, $x=-1$ or $x=-2$.**
